comparison.objective: Move a fragile egg off a trivet before placing a pot on it.
comparison.physical_skill: Obstruction recognition, delicate object relocation, heavy-object placement, and collision-force avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Egg clears the trivet, pot is upright and supported on it, egg remains safely supported, hands withdraw, and excessive pot–egg contact or falling permanently fails.
comparison.reason: This tests safe precedence and placement around a fragile obstruction, not loose-body separation by aperture size. No comparison-critical detail is missing.
